steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Engineering geology applies geological knowledge to civil engineering: site investigation, rock properties, and hazard assessment | Key Fact: Site investigation: desk study, walkover survey, boreholes, trial pits, geophysical surveys, and laboratory testing | Key Fact: Key rock properties: strength, permeability, porosity, discontinuities (joints, faults), and weathering grade | Key Fact: Foundation design depends on bearing capacity: strong bedrock supports heavy structures; weak clay requires deep foundations

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from engineering geology, and one past-paper question.
